_why: Every number on docs/PLAN-2.0-GAP.md that is a count of something in this repository, with the file or generated artifact that owns it. The page writes the number followed by `<!-- plan-fact:<id> -->`, which renders as nothing; `scripts/check_plan_rows.py` recomputes each fact and fails when the page and the repository disagree, when a marker names an undefined fact, and when a fact is defined but no longer quoted. Run 204 swept these by hand and found eight stale numbers, which is why they are data now. Add a fact when a new count is worth failing a build over; do not add one for a number whose owner is a suite run (that is check_all's job) or an external fact.
